R._comment: Relational schema extraction (relational_schema.py). source_preference: a table is decided entirely by the first source that defines it; lower sources only add tables the higher ones do not mention. type_families/sequelize_types are lookup tables, not a verified mapping of every PostgreSQL type.
R._doc_versions: Labels of the versioned documentation sets (r2-additional-requirements.md, 'Documentation versioning'), latest first. The ER model and the README are read from docs/<label>/ (folder matched case-insensitively: docs/r2 too) before the original paths; inside the folder, entity-relationship-model.md, or else the first .md with a Mermaid erDiagram.

CREATE TABLE users (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.products (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (price >= 0),
  stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  CONSTRAINT products_stock_nonneg CHECK (stock >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  total NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT orders_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped'))
);

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
